IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Senators McAuliffe, Eide, Kohl-Welles and Rasmussen

Bill.BriefDescription: Changing the disposition of proceeds from the rental or lease of school district real property.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the disposition of funds received from therental or lease of school district real property; amending RCW28A.335.060; and providing an effective date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 28A.335.060 and 1989 c 86 s 2 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Each school district's board of directors shall deposit moneysderived from the lease, rental, or occasional use of surplus schoolproperty as follows: (1) Moneys derived from real property shall be deposited ((into thedistrict's debt service fund and/or capital projects fund except formoneys required to be expended for general maintenance, utility,insurance costs, and any other costs associated with the lease orrental of such property, which moneys shall be deposited in thedistrict's general)) as follows: (a) Amounts required to be expended for general maintenance,utility, insurance costs, and other costs associated with the lease orrental of such property shall be deposited in the district's generalfund; p. 1 SB 5416 (b) Additional amounts shall be deposited in the district's generalfund for general maintenance, utility, insurance costs, and other costsdirectly associated with district property; the district's debt servicefund; and/or the district's capital projects fund; (2) Moneys derived from pupil transportation vehicles shall bedeposited in the district's transportation vehicle fund; (3) Moneys derived from other personal property shall be depositedin the district's general fund.
